== Description ==

[[Hayes Hunter]] (right, grey overshirt, beard, longer brown hair, playing cards), [[Patrick Johnson]] (left, grey X-wing 1977 T-shirt, dark hair, holding a card), [[Mike Kessling]] (background stream table, left player in a blue tee facing the camera), and [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (background stream table, right player in a black hoodie, back to camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
